_comment: Claude Code MCP config for the UE 5.8 built-in MCP plugin. Copy the mcpServers block into your project's .mcp.json (or run the `claude mcp add` command in AUTOMATION.md). Replace <PORT> with the real port shown in UE: Editor > Edit > Plugins > MCP (or the Output Log line 'MCP server listening on ...'). The endpoint only exists while the Editor is open with the plugin enabled AND Toolset registries enabled.
